title: Control and supervision exception
description: Exception to the exercise of powers and discharge of functions

content.general_rule: Every Additional Director-General, Director, Joint Director, Deputy Director and Assistant Director shall exercise his powers, and discharge his functions
content.exception: subject to the general control, supervision and direction of the Director-General
conditions: subject to the general control, supervision and direction of the Director-General
